messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
I'll look that up for you now.

Your two Harlo B30s and the Power Kit are paid and still to ship. They go out November 7, from the batch rework we wrote to you about on September 15 (quieter cooling, price locked, free Power Kit added).

Nothing has shipped yet, so no tracking yet. You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Anything else I can check for you?
Before you go, one thing: what made you go with two B30s rather than a single bigger unit?
2 different locations. One at home. One at the office.
Makes sense. Both units are set to ship to the one address on the order. Do you want the office one sent somewhere else, or are you splitting them yourself once they land?
I'll run them both at home through the winter and then move one in the spring.

Good plan, two of them put out real heat in one room.

One last thing: what nearly won instead of the B30 when you were deciding?
Avalon Q was my first choice

That's useful, thanks. Two B30s was the right call over the Q for a home room anyway, quieter and far less power.

Your November 7 date is on the order, and tracking comes to this email the moment it ships. Enjoy the winter heat.
